title: DM2DMM4

[[Image:Dm2dmm4.jpg|240px|right|thumb|DM2 bigroom]]
'''DM2DMM4''' a replica of the [[DM2]] bigroom, intended for [[Deathmatch Mode 4|dmm4]] play, by [[Image:flag_au.gif]] [[Povo-Hat]]. The room is exactly the same, except that all exits are blocked off and you cannot open the lava floor.

==Gameplay==
[[Image:Dm2dmm4a.jpg|240px|right|thumb|Colored boxes]]
When you spawn, you briefly drop through a coloured box that indicates which area you will be entering from. The colors correspond as follows:
* Brown: Lower YA tele entrance
* Red: Platforms entrance
* Yellow: RA-Mega tele entrance
* Blue: Quad entrance
